title: Understanding Model Pricing
excerpt: How input and output tokens are billed, and what a credit is really worth.

content.h: Tokens are the unit of billing 🔢

content.p: Every request is billed per token. Input tokens are what you send, output tokens are what the model replies with.
Generating text is more expensive than reading it. Most providers price output tokens higher than input tokens.
Your balance is measured in credits, which map 1:1 to the platform currency. The panel shows the exact credit cost of each model before you send a request.

list: Pick mini models for easy tasks

faq.a: A token is a chunk of text the model reads or writes — roughly four characters for English.

faq.q: Why does output cost more than input?
faq.a: Generating new text is more compute-intensive than reading your prompt, so output tokens are priced higher.

faq.q: Where can I see per-model prices?
faq.a: The panel shows the exact credit cost of each model before you send a request.

faq.q: How can I lower my bill?
faq.a: Shorten prompts, cap output tokens and pick mini models for simple tasks.
